$comment: D443 T6 voice and excitement (services/clip/excitement.py post-stream, services/event-core/voice-marks.mjs live). Every threshold, weight and window here is a first proposal, not measured on the user's voice or streams: status unverified, approvedBy null. Event weights need the user's approval (AGENTS.md: never invented as final). Marker phrases are the user's own answer of 2026-11-24 (Malayalam script, Manglish Latin spellings, English); a phrase only marks the moment, it never acts on the stream.

phrases.note: latin: matched as whole words after lower-casing and folding repeated letters (adipoliii = adipoli); a variant with a space must appear as adjacent words. malayalam: matched as a part of a word (Malayalam joins endings to words), after Unicode NFC.

voice.note: Per second of the recording's audio: loudness (RMS dBFS) and pitch (autocorrelation, voiced 50 ms frames) against the speaker's own rolling baseline (median/MAD of the earlier voiced seconds). A rise of zFull MADs or more counts as 1.

events.note: Laughter and shouting from the YAMNet audio-event model (download item audio-events, CPU only). Class indexes from yamnet_class_map.csv at the pinned revision. A per-second probability of full or more counts as 1.

chat.note: Chat rate over windowSec against the session median; ratio x median (at least minMessages) counts as 1.

weights.note: Share of each part in the per-second excitement score (0..1). Proposal; needs the user's approval.

rank.note: Post-stream: a second whose score reaches threshold opens a 'voice.excitement' event (strength = score) in the clip ranking; a marker phrase opens a 'voice.phrase' event. At most one of each per minGapSec. Weights are on the scale of data/clip/ranking.json weights.

live.note: Live: a marker phrase in the live transcript writes one host marker (source audio), at most one per phrase per minGapSec and one in total per anyGapSec. Never acts on the stream.
